name: M64/60 piston with cooling gallery, CP1 F0 concept
description: Independent concept of an Aheadd CP1 LPBF piston with a toroidal gallery under the crown and two temporary depowdering ports. Only the M64/60 bore/stroke/engine speed and the Porsche methodological precedent are published; the entire piston geometry remains an F0 hypothesis.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, plate mechanics, inertia, pin pressure, conduction and gallery hydraulics screening; no manufacturing, installation or engine start authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, Porsche/MAHLE/Swindon surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - additive piston precedent and 993 pistons
sources.notes: Establishes the candidate and the closed-gallery precedent only; no 993 CP1 geometry or grade. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-ADDITIVE-PISTON-PRECEDENT.

sources.title: Porsche Newsroom - laser-fused pistons
sources.notes: For the modern GT2 RS project, Porsche states a load-adapted structure, 10% less mass, a closed gallery under the crown and 200 h of engine testing. Method reference only, with no transfer to the 993. See SRC-PORSCHE-ADDITIVE-PISTON-VALIDATION.

sources.title: elferclassic - German technical data of the 993 Turbo
sources.notes: Publishes six cylinders, 100 mm bore, 76.4 mm stroke and a 6,720 +/- 20 rpm limiter. These engine values do not define the piston. See SRC-ELFERCLASSIC-993-TURBO-TECHNICAL-DATA.

sources.title: Velo3D - Aheadd CP1 Material & Process Capability
sources.notes: Publishes, for Sapphire/50 µm, machined vertical specimens and 400 °C/4 h: density 2.67 g/cm3, minimum Rp0.2 297 MPa and minimum Rm 331 MPa. These are not hot/fatigue piston allowables. See SRC-VELO3D-CP1-MATERIAL-DATASHEET.

sources.title: Constellium - Aheadd CP1 product fact sheet
sources.notes: Publishes 187 W/m.K at room temperature and qualitative stability over several thousand hours at 250-300 °C, without a full hot property map. See SRC-CONSTELLIUM-AHEADD-CP1-PRODUCT-SHEET.

sources.title: IAV / GVSETS 2018 - additive diesel piston
sources.notes: Architecture precedent: triangulated lattice and separate cooling circuits on a heavy-duty diesel piston of about 130 mm. No dimension or property is transferred to the M64/60 CP1. See SRC-IAV-2018-ADDITIVE-HEAVY-DUTY-PISTON.

material.grade: Constellium Aheadd CP1, Velo3D Sapphire 50 µm route for screening only
material.standard: AMS7074 for the powder and a program-specific piston/machine specification to be contracted

post_processing: controlled removal of all powder through two opposed temporary ports
400 °C treatment for 4 h per the published route, to be requalified on the part
HIP to be decided after analysis of defects, fatigue and the gallery
port closure by a qualified process, then proof test and CT of the gallery
machining of the diameter, skirt, ring grooves, pin bores and datum faces
finishing, anti-friction coating, pin/ring matching and set balancing
supplier_requirements: traceable CP1 powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
oriented coupons with tensile, fatigue, creep, conductivity and expansion from room temperature to the qualified temperature
distortion simulation and witnesses for crown, gallery, bosses and ring grooves
CT before and after machining/port closure, gallery porosity and thickness contracted
metrology of skirt profile, ovality, taper, compression height, ring grooves, pin and end-to-end mass
hydraulic proof test, thermomechanical cycles, full-scale fatigue and 200 h engine testing before vehicle

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify tribology and compatibility of CP1 with the steel pin, rings, skirt coatings, nickel-silicon carbide cylinder, oil and combustion products.

known_limits: The 100 mm engine bore, the 76.4 mm stroke and the limiter are documentary; no 993 piston dimension is published here.
The F0 99 mm diameter, 70 mm height, cavity, pin, ring grooves, bowl and gallery are entirely synthetic.
The Porsche precedent, 10% lighter, closed gallery and 200 h, concerns a modern 911 GT2 RS piston, not this F0 nor a 993.
The CAD mass of 681.32 g depends on the synthetic shape and is not compared with any measured 993 piston mass.
The 12 MPa cylinder pressure, the pin/ring masses, the 2 l/min of oil, 5 kW and +200 K are unmeasured regression cases.
The room-temperature margin of 1.07 from a circular plate and a minimum CP1 limit is not a hot design margin.
The 1D models ignore transient combustion, skirt/cylinder contact, rings, lubrication, oil acceleration and multiaxial fatigue.
The slicing into 2,390 layers, the roll_y_45 orientation and the 8.365 cm3 of supports are a geometric screen; no Flow project, distortion field or recoater check is available.
The SimReady pass validates an isolated prop, not the piston-cylinder-rings-pin-connecting rod assembly nor the engine function.

The PicoGK F0 sweep inspired by the Porsche and IAV architectures generated six variants and up to 1.60% gross weight saving, but none passes the provisional room-temperature plate margin of 1.50 and all six STLs keep non-manifold edges.

The sound BREP master went through six CalculiX runs on three meshes: the hot p95 reaches 323.46 MPa and exceeds the room-temperature CP1 reference of 297 MPa in the synthetic case, despite a mesh sensitivity below 1% on that p95.
PicoGK is a geometry kernel; without FEA of the manifold variants, CHT/VOF, hot CP1 allowables and measured interfaces, no variant constitutes an optimized or selected piston.
The STEP proves only a readable BREP with a gallery opened by two ports; it is authorized neither for manufacturing, nor fitting, nor engine use.
